pipeline.name: DAAD Research Grants, Doctoral Programmes in Germany
pipeline.institution: DAAD, via the Regional Office in Hanoi
pipeline.next_action: Get DAAD to confirm in writing that the Dr. sc. hum. is fundable, draft the supervision and ethics letter for Mueller to sign, and cut the proposal from nine pages to about seven so the previous-research section fits the ten-page combined limit.
pipeline.notes: Funding runs from October 2027. DAAD excludes Dr. med., Dr. med. vet. and Dr. med. dent. from funding and funds Dr. rer. nat., Dr. rer. medic. and Dr. rer. med., so Mueller's suggestion that the Dr. med. is the easier route would make the application ineligible. Pending MPH conferral against the degree certificate requirement is unresolved.

pipeline.institution: Lead targets Sydney (Greg Fox), Burnet Institute via Monash (Myanmar Program), LSTM (Sally Theobald)
pipeline.next_action: Book IELTS Academic. pipeline.notes: Runs beside the TB-and-conflict route. Eighteen targets scored on 6 October 2026, rows 20-37 in PhD_Board_rows_IR_Route_2026-10-06.xlsx. pipeline.name: Dr. sc. hum., supervision agreed with Olaf Mueller
pipeline.next_action: Get an ECTS or credit-value statement from BRAC. It is the blocking document for Heidelberg admission and it answers the Stockholm methods credit question at the same time.
pipeline.notes: Mueller agreed to supervise and to sign the DAAD supervision and ethics letter, on condition that Muang drafts it. Denkinger declined for lack of capacity and that route is closed. Yesim Tozan would advise on the panel component. Heidelberg's Dr. sc. hum. rules generally exclude a medical degree alone and admit medical graduates holding a relevant non-clinical Master's of at least 120 ECTS, with a conditional route at 60 ECTS plus 60 of extra coursework. The BRAC MPH states no credit values.
